details:
Q1: Which parts of the proposal are in scope for this issue?
Choices:
A. Items 1-3 only: an opt-in weekly `schedule:` in `workflow-templates/ai-validate.yml` (gated by `AI_VALIDATE_SCHEDULE_ENABLED`, default off), default-branch runs with `tracking_issue=0`, plus a sink for red scheduled runs (RECOMMENDED)
B. Item 4 only: give `validation-refresh.yml` red results a sink; no wrapper schedule
C. Both A and B in this issue
D. A now; file B as a separate follow-up issue
Q2: What cadence should the scheduled run use? GitHub does not read repo variables inside `on.schedule`, so the cron is fixed in the managed template and the same for every consumer that opts in.
Choices:
A. Weekly, at a fixed off-peak time (for example Monday 04:00 UTC) (RECOMMENDED)
B. Daily
C. Weekly cron, with a second variable that lets a consumer skip ticks to run every N weeks
Q3: Which LLM phases should a scheduled run use?
Choices:
A. Run as it does today: harness generate, diagnose and self-heal, if a harness or repair is needed
B. Deterministic only: run the existing `.ai/validate.yml` / committed harness with no generate, diagnose or self-heal model calls; a red result just goes to the sink (RECOMMENDED)
C. Allow generate and diagnose but turn self-heal off (`MAX_SELF_HEAL_ATTEMPTS=0`), so the scheduled run never commits repairs
**Note:** B costs the least, but a consumer that has never had a harness generated will report red (or `harness_error`) on every run until one exists.
Q4: Where should a red scheduled run be reported so it is not silent?
Choices:
A. One deduplicated issue in the consumer repo (a stable marker per repo, a label such as `ai:scheduled-validation-failed`), updated in place while it stays red and closed when a later scheduled run passes, plus one WARNING alert when it opens (RECOMMENDED)
B. A workflow-failure heal report dispatched to coding-workflows (new kind or a `SCHEDULED_CHECK_WORKFLOW_NAMES`-style entry), which the intake classifies as workflow-defect or consumer-app-defect
C. Telegram WARNING only, no issue
**Note:** if A's issue carries no exclusion label, it enters the consumer's clarify→plan→implement pipeline, which spends LLM calls even if Q3 is B. Choose whether that is wanted, or the issue gets an exclusion like `ai:retro` / `ai:security-audit`.
